title: Email Reader Specification
description: Requirements specification for an email reader focused on message browsing, sorting, grouping, selection and traceable requirements engineering.

architecture.principle: separate email data access, domain model, API and presentation

user_stories.title: Browse folder messages
user_stories.i_want: to see the messages in a selected folder
user_stories.so_that: I can review my email efficiently

user_stories.title: Sort messages
user_stories.i_want: to sort messages by DATE, FROM and SUBJECT
user_stories.so_that: I can find relevant messages quickly

user_stories.title: Group messages
user_stories.i_want: messages grouped by FROM and SUBJECT
user_stories.so_that: I can recognize related messages quickly
acceptance_criteria: Each FROM group contains SUBJECT groups

user_stories.title: Select messages
user_stories.i_want: to select one or multiple messages
user_stories.so_that: I can inspect a chosen set of messages

user_stories.title: Read a message
user_stories.i_want: to read the selected message and its metadata
user_stories.so_that: I can understand its content and context

user_stories.title: Protect email data
acceptance_criteria: Message content is not unnecessarily exposed

use_cases.name: Read Message
use_cases.goal: Display a selected email safely and completely.
use_cases.description: The user selects a message and reads its metadata and body.

exception_flows.name: Message unavailable
steps: Show an error without exposing credentials or internal details

use_cases.name: Sort Messages
use_cases.goal: Present messages in a user-selected order.
use_cases.description: The user sorts the current message list by DATE, FROM or SUBJECT.
postconditions: Message order reflects the selected attribute
acceptance_criteria: All supported sort attributes produce deterministic ordering

use_cases.name: Group Selected Messages
use_cases.goal: Summarize selected messages using FROM and SUBJECT groups.
use_cases.description: The system presents selected messages using nested FROM and SUBJECT groups with counts.
postconditions: Selection summary and nested groups are displayed
acceptance_criteria: Heading contains folder and selection statistics

use_cases.name: Change Folder
use_cases.goal: Switch the message context to another mail folder.
use_cases.description: The user selects another folder and the system loads its messages.

exception_flows.name: Folder cannot be loaded
steps: Report the failure and keep the previous context where possible

acceptance_criteria: Folder changes are reflected in the message list

use_cases.name: Configure Account
use_cases.goal: Make an email account available to the reader.
use_cases.description: An authorized user configures an email account and its connection settings.
use_cases.trigger: User adds or edits an account
postconditions: Account configuration is available for use

actors.name: Email User
actors.description: Person using the email reader to browse and read messages.

actors.name: Email Server
actors.description: External mail service providing accounts, folders and messages.

actors.name: Email Reader
actors.description: Application responsible for loading, organizing and displaying email.

api_requirements.title: Account API
api_requirements.statement: The API shall expose account configuration and connection operations.

api_requirements.title: Folder API
api_requirements.statement: The API shall expose available folders and folder selection context.

api_requirements.title: Message API
api_requirements.statement: The API shall expose message list and message detail operations.

api_requirements.title: Selection API
api_requirements.statement: The API shall support selection and grouped message data required by the UI.

api_requirements.title: Refresh API
api_requirements.statement: The API shall support refreshing folder message data.

gui_requirements.title: Folder navigation
gui_requirements.statement: The GUI shall provide clear folder navigation.

gui_requirements.title: Message list
gui_requirements.statement: The GUI shall provide a message list with sorting controls.

gui_requirements.title: FROM grouping
gui_requirements.statement: The GUI shall show FROM groups with counts.

gui_requirements.title: SUBJECT grouping
gui_requirements.statement: The GUI shall show SUBJECT groups nested within FROM groups with counts.

gui_requirements.title: Selection heading
gui_requirements.statement: The GUI shall show folder, selection count and distinct FROM count for multiple selections.

gui_requirements.title: Message pane
gui_requirements.statement: The GUI shall display message metadata and body.

gui_requirements.title: Safe HTML
gui_requirements.statement: The GUI shall render message HTML safely.

gui_requirements.title: Refresh control
gui_requirements.statement: The GUI shall provide a refresh action.

traceability.principle: Every implemented behavior should be traceable from a user-facing requirement to one or more model elements and verification criteria.

requirements.title: Create test repository
requirements.statement: The system shall create the GitHub repository MartinWirth/test-email-reader if it does not exist.

requirements.title: Manage email accounts
requirements.statement: The system shall configure and access one or more email accounts.

requirements.title: Manage folders
requirements.statement: The system shall display accessible mail folders and allow the user to select a folder.

requirements.title: Load messages
requirements.statement: The system shall load messages belonging to the selected folder.

requirements.title: Display message list
requirements.statement: The system shall display the messages of the selected folder in a list.

requirements.title: Sort messages
requirements.statement: The system shall sort the message list by DATE, FROM and SUBJECT.

requirements.title: Group messages
requirements.statement: The system shall group displayed messages by FROM and within each FROM group by SUBJECT.

requirements.title: Display group counts
requirements.statement: The system shall display the number of messages for every FROM and SUBJECT group.

requirements.title: Select messages
requirements.statement: The system shall allow the user to select one or multiple messages.

requirements.title: Multiple-selection heading
requirements.statement: For multiple selected messages, the message pane heading shall contain the folder name, number of selected messages and number of different FROM values.

requirements.title: FROM group heading
requirements.statement: Each FROM group shall display the FROM value and the number of messages at the beginning of the group line.

requirements.title: SUBJECT group heading
requirements.statement: Each SUBJECT group within a FROM group shall display the SUBJECT value and the number of messages at the beginning of the group line.

requirements.title: Preserve sorted order
requirements.statement: Messages shall retain the active sorting order within their groups.

requirements.title: Open message
requirements.statement: The system shall display the complete selected message in the message pane.

requirements.title: Display message metadata
requirements.statement: The message pane shall display FROM, TO, CC, DATE and SUBJECT.

requirements.title: Display message body
requirements.statement: The system shall display the message body in a readable format.

requirements.title: Handle HTML safely
requirements.statement: HTML message content shall be sanitized before being rendered in the application.

requirements.title: Display attachments
requirements.statement: The system shall display available attachments and their metadata.

requirements.title: Refresh folder
requirements.statement: The system shall allow the user to refresh the selected folder and retrieve current messages.

requirements.title: Maintain selection
requirements.statement: The system shall maintain selection state while the user changes the presentation of the current message list where technically possible.

requirements.title: Keyboard interaction
requirements.statement: The system shall support keyboard selection and opening of messages.

requirements.title: Search messages
requirements.statement: The system shall support searching messages by relevant message attributes and content.

requirements.title: Thread view
requirements.statement: The system shall support an optional conversation or thread view.

requirements.title: Bulk operations
requirements.statement: The system shall support bulk operations on selected messages such as archive, move and delete.

requirements.title: Privacy
requirements.statement: Email content and credentials shall not be exposed to unauthorized users or external services.

requirements.title: Credential security
requirements.statement: Email credentials shall be stored and transmitted using appropriate security mechanisms and shall not be persisted in plain text.

requirements.title: Performance
requirements.statement: The message list shall remain responsive when displaying large folders by using pagination, incremental loading or another scalable mechanism.

requirements.title: Reliability
requirements.statement: Temporary email-server failures shall be reported clearly without losing already loaded local UI state.

requirements.title: Accessibility
requirements.statement: The user interface shall provide keyboard-accessible controls, meaningful labels and sufficient visual distinction.

requirements.title: Auditability
requirements.statement: Important message operations shall be traceable in application logs without logging message content or credentials unnecessarily.

requirements.title: Testability
requirements.statement: Core grouping, sorting and selection behavior shall be testable independently from the user interface.
